To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the reliability of the connection setup of mobile IoT devices is limited by the physical-layer and that the reliability can be improved by exploiting the physical-layer properties.

(1) the reliability of wireless communication is a crucial requirement in the IoT, (2) the reliability of a communication link depends on the properties of the wireless channel, and (3) a reliable communication link can be established by using a low-power operation.

the following two factors are the main contributors to the reliability and dependability of the connection setup: the collision resolution mechanism and the power management scheme of the radio hardware.
In summary, our research is concerned with
designing a reliable and dependable communication protocol that can be used for establishing a first contact and hence, for realizing a dependable operation of mobile wireless devices in the IoT.
the question how reliable communication can be achieved in a power-constrained setting.
designing a reliable and dependable connection establishment procedure for mobile IoT devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of a protocol that meets all the above-mentioned requirements is a non-trivial problem.
a highly dependable operation can only realized if the energy-constraints are significantly relaxed or the energy-efficiency of the hardware is increased.
the reliability and dependability of a connection setup procedure can be improved by increasing the transmission power of devices, which in turn, increases the energy consumption.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a power-aware reliable communication scheme that allows IoT devices to establish reliable connections in a highly dependable manner, while at the very same time meeting the stringent energy constraints of IoT devices.

the design of a reliable and energy-efficient wireless protocol for IoT devices is challenging, as the protocol design has to take into account the characteristics of the wireless medium, the energy-constrained operation of the devices and the requirements of the application.
the design of robust protocols is not only a matter of the design of the wireless protocol, but also a question of the hardware design of the wireless device.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to realize reliable connected communication for IoT devices, a careful consideration of the wireless hardware properties is necessary.
the energy-constraints on IoT devices are so tight, that the only way to design reliable and dependable wireless protocols is to exploit the properties of the wireless channel.
the reliability of the connection setup can be improved substantially, by exploiting the power-aware capabilities of modern hardware.
